snippet.title: 3 Switch Problem // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4840960/3_Switch_Problem

A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer:  ATMAC Games
📚 Publisher:  ATMAC Games
📅 Release Date: Oct 26, 2026
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie
